note: SNG-245 (Aevi 2026-07-27): the HOOK VOICE bank for the Pressure Queue. CCode's producers emit a flat template ('X, unseen for N days, has come looking...') that reads as a system event. This bank gives each pressure KIND varied, story-beat phrasings the producer picks from (by rng), + per-NPC-drive overrides for the SNG-233 interiority NPCs so a driven knock sounds like THAT person. Tokens: {name} {absent} {want} {threat} {place}. The chosen string becomes the oneLineHook -> the GM's driven directive. Voice is a story beat arriving, never a notification.

generic: {name} is here — not summoned, not stumbled upon. {absent} days unseen, and a want went unmet long enough to bring them to your door: {want} They've come to close the distance themselves.
You feel it before you see them: {name}, arrived. {absent} days is long enough. What they want has stopped waiting to be noticed — {want} — and now it's standing in front of you.
{name} came looking. Not idly — {absent} days of an unmet want will move a person, and theirs has moved them here: {want} They mean to have it out with you, one way or another.
Someone's been waiting on you, and stopped. {name} is here, {absent} days' worth of a want gone unanswered behind their eyes: {want} They didn't send word. They came.

pell: Pell is here, and she is not smiling. {absent} days you've been elsewhere, and Pell does not wait well for what she considers hers — {want} She's come to find out where your attention went, and she'll want a straight answer.

You know that set of the shoulders. Pell, arrived unannounced, {absent} days of your absence gone hot in her: {want} She measures love in presence, and you've been short on it. Now she's standing in your doorway making that plain.
veth-ondra: Veth is at your door, still as ever and twice as cold. {absent} days, and something in your conduct has failed the craft as she holds it — {want} She has come to say so to your face, because a warden does not let a wrong ending stand.
Stillwater has come to find you. {absent} days unseen, and Veth's judgment has hardened into a visit: {want} She will tell you exactly where you strayed, and she will be, as usual, mostly right.
mara-wells: Mara's shut the store and come to you — which she does not do lightly. {absent} days, and something needs squaring that a message won't fix: {want} She's brought the true version, and she expects the same from you.
huginn: The rook is here, and it did not follow — it CAME. {absent} days, and Huginn has settled where you'll see it, one eye steady: {want} It attends something ending, or about to, and it means for you to attend it too.
ama: Your mother is here. She finished what she was doing first, then came — {absent} days, and something has pulled her from her own quiet to yours: {want} She won't perform the worry. She'll just be here, and let you feel its weight.

generic: A {threat} has come down onto you here — not blundered into, ARRIVED, and hunting. There's no easing away from this one. Defend, or drive it off.
The {threat} chose this. It came to where you are, deliberate and wrong, and it is between you and the way out. This is a fight you were brought, not one you went looking for — meet it or run it.
You have time for one breath before the {threat} is on you. It hunted here on purpose. Stand and defend, or break and flee — but decide now.
Something arrived at {place} with teeth and intent: a {threat}, come hunting, and it has found you. Not a chance encounter — a chosen one. Defend.
threat-attack.note: threat-attack ALWAYS becomes a defend-encounter (teeth); the hook telegraphs the stakes + preserves flee (SNG-230 round-1 flee rule). Never remove the decline/flee path from the voice.

_futureKinds.villain-move: (producer not yet wired) voice: the villain's scheme reaches the player's orbit - 'the Pure-of-Ash's mercy has reached a village you know; the killing is being called kindness, and it is coming your way.'
_futureKinds.arc-stir: (not yet wired) voice: a greater arc tremors AT the player - 'the deep under {place} shifted while you slept; What Wakes Beneath has turned toward you, and the water remembers.'
_futureKinds.treasure-rumor: (not yet wired) voice: a real reward rumors itself toward the player - 'a delver at the fire swears the vault you passed still holds its wardings unbroken - and what a pre-Transition maker sealed, no one since has opened.'

howProducersUse: Each producer, when it builds an entry, picks a phrasing: for npc-want, use byNpc[npcId] if present (the SNG-233 interiority NPCs), else generic[]; pick by rng so repeats vary. Substitute tokens ({name}/{absent}/{want}/{threat}/{place}). The result is the oneLineHook. Fallback to CCode's current template if the bank is unavailable (graceful degrade). Keep {want} clamped ~160 as CCode does.
